assumptions: Adjacency is the finite snapshot already assembled from committed binding, parent-child and candidate-provider facts. Correct graph construction, realm/minor matching and snapshot concurrency are separate source obligations.
The abstract pending list is the reverse of Rust's Vec stack; each adjacency list is represented in the corresponding pop order. Reversal preserves edge and root membership.
Rust HashSet membership/insertion corresponds to selected-list membership guarded by fresh insertion. dependents.remove corresponds to takeNeighbors on the finite map representation.
The proof has no fixed vertex, edge, path-length or root-count bound. Cycles, duplicate roots, self edges and absent catalog names are included.
The returned-instance theorem describes set membership after catalog filtering. Rust sort_unstable determines the concrete output order and HashMap/Arc semantics remain outside Lean.

evidence_commands.purpose: Runs the existing deployment model and the independent 512 three-node graph/seed regression cases; these finite cases supplement the arbitrary-size Lean proof.
Exercises selected-instance checkpoint, detach and shutdown freeze through the real process manager.
